title: Login form crashes when email contains '+'
body: Repro: visit /login, enter `foo+bar@example.com`, submit. Stack trace in #12.

title: Add dark mode toggle to settings page
body: User Story: as a user, I want a dark mode toggle. Persist choice in localStorage. Respect prefers-color-scheme on first load.

title: Document the new caching layer
body: We added Redis-backed caching last sprint. README needs a section on cache keys, invalidation, and TTLs.

title: Race condition in checkout: double-charge on retry
body: When the payment provider returns a 5xx and we retry, some users get charged twice. Critical. Owner: payments team.
